overview_description.description: Kosh is a financial services platform designed for service providers. The platform uses sophisticated machine learning algorithms to recommend savings plans, allowing blue-collar workers to turn into micro-lenders for their community. Kosh aims to provide affordable credit, automated saving plans in the easiest way possible.

about_short_description.short_description: Kosh is a financial services platform designed to help people become financially independent.

product.name: Instant Loan
product.description: Provides loans up to Rs 2,00,000 directly to users' bank accounts with a paperless application process.

product.name: Lower Interest Rate
product.description: Offers loans with interest rates that are lower compared to typical market rates for similar credit products.

product.name: Flexible EMIs
product.description: Allows borrowers to select their preferred EMI date and amount to suit their financial convenience.

product.name: Paperless Process
product.description: Facilitates loan applications through a fully digital process requiring personal details and KYC document uploads without physical paperwork.

product.name: Earn Cashback
product.description: Provides users with cashback rewards when they refer friends or family who apply for loans on the platform.

product.name: Community Network
product.description: Enables users to connect, learn, and share financial knowledge with friends and acquaintances within the platform.
